mapper.select: SELECT id,rca_title title,root_cause description,solution,confidence,rca_status status,orchestration_version,correlation_result correlation_json,impact_result impact_json,validation_status,validation_detail validation_json,facts_sha256,created_at FROM t_root_cause_analysis WHERE incident_id=#{incidentId} AND rca_type=#{type} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
